before: The spaceship moves horizontally at 300 px/s and cannot leave the gameplay area.
after: The spaceship moves horizontally at 380 px/s and cannot leave the gameplay area.

before: While `running`, the game processes player movement and shooting, updates player bullets, moves the current enemy formation downward, advances the wave-level firing timer, spawns enemy bullets when required, and updates active enemy bullets.
after: While `running`, the game processes player movement at 380 px/s and shooting, updates player bullets, moves the current enemy formation downward, advances the wave-level firing timer, spawns enemy bullets when required, and updates active enemy bullets.
